messages:
elaine: opened PR to update model-catalog + polarion model-card; replacing legacy curl examples with SDK v3 snippets and adding a short Dedicated runbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523
elainE: (typo in previous) main changes: clarify supported quant variants, explicit seq/eff-seq table, embed-sharding example, pin benchmark row to runner commit ghi789
tom: can you add a one-line "what changed" at the very top for release notes? ops scans that first
elainE: added: "Catalog update: clarifies variant support, updates long-context limits, and changes edge-quant KV retention behavior."
viv: small nit: normalize on term "variant" not "profile" across the card. also add a one-sentence forensic note about edge-quant behavior
elainE: added forensic sentence: "edge-quant may evict older KV buckets at different boundaries compared to classic quant; apps depending on KV lifetime should pin a compat variant or legacy variant."
carl: embed-shard math looked off. use ceil(total_tokens / shard_size). also remind users tokenizer is model-dependent and show using /tokenize first
elainE: fixed math and added a Python snippet showing tokenize -> shard calculation:
```
# python (sketch)
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
counts = [c.tokenize(t) for t in texts]
shard_size = 1500
num_shards = (sum(counts) + shard_size - 1) // shard_size
```
tom: support asked for Dedicated runbook to be 3 actionable steps (pin, validate, resize). can you make it minimal and explicit
elainE: added "Dedicated quick runbook": 1) Pin model version in Console before catalog change. 2) Mirror 1% traffic to a test pool for validation. 3) Open support ticket to resize reserved pools if throughput/latency differ. short and explicit
docs-bot: linkcheck summary: 1 external 404 fixed (benchmarks), 1 anchor unresolved (runtime-router). re-run scheduled on merge
viv: please pin the benchmark table rows to the runner commit (ghi789) so it doesn't drift
carl: also please add a one-liner about "max_seq vs effective_seq" (effective_seq = max_seq - reserved_prefix). customers keep asking
elainE: added a tiny diagram and the one-liner. will squash fixups and merge after docs-bot clears and Carl's local validation runs green. thanks all :tada:
